If you know the chromosome and the region you can query the
GenomeInformation file about the unit indices (as indexed by the CDF),
and then query the CDF for the SNP names of these units. Example:

> cdf <- AffymetrixCdfFile$byChipType("Mapping250K_Sty")
> gi <- getGenomeInformation(cdf)

# Units on Chr18 in 0-400kb
> units <- getUnitsOnChromosome(gi, chromosome=18, region=c(0,400e3))
> str(units)
int [1:461] 1122 1692 1783 2593 3833 3864 5936 6065 6119 6374 ...

# Units on Chr18 in 0-200kb
> units <- getUnitsOnChromosome(gi, chromosome=18, region=c(0,200e3))
> str(units)
int [1:165] 18620 21912 22288 24037 26680 30929 36893 40021 46805 51821 ...
> unitNames <- getUnitNames(cdf, units)
> str(unitNames)
chr [1:165] "SNP_A-2174912" "SNP_A-1826004" "SNP_A-2079863" ...
> unitPos <- getPositions(gi, units)
> str(unitPos)
int [1:165] 198147 121788 62481 165712 165407 165844 110632 190631 ...

You have to do the same for 'Mapping250K_Nsp' and then merge your data.

/Henrik
